INSERT INTO pin (pin_id, user_id, title, description, image_url, link_url, created_at) VALUES (#{pinId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT pin_id, user_id, title, description, image_url, link_url, created_at, updated_at FROM pin WHERE pin_id = #{pinId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pin SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE pin_id = #{pinId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.pin_id, p.image_url, p.title, p.description, p.link_url, (SELECT board_id FROM saved_pin sp WHERE sp.pin_id = p.pin_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS board_id, p.created_at FROM pin p WHERE p.pin_id = #{pinId}
SELECT u.user_id, u.profile_img AS profile_image_url FROM pin p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.pin_id = #{pinId}
SELECT t.tag_name FROM pin_tag pt JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.pin_id = #{pinId} ORDER BY t.tag_name
SELECT user_id FROM pin WHERE pin_id = #{pinId}
